# Allan Niñal — AI and Software Engineer

> Allan Niñal is an AI and Software Engineer based in Talisay, Cebu, Philippines (UTC+8). He builds AI-powered tools, data products, and load-bearing AWS automation — owned end to end, from data engineering and AI/ML through to fullstack apps and the cloud infrastructure (DNS, SSL, servers) they run on. He ships in public: a free MIT-licensed website template every day, 73 AWS automation blueprints, and 25 Philippine open-data analyses.

## Main site

- [Home](https://www.allanninal.dev/): Portfolio overview — products, services, data & AI work, and about.
- [Services](https://www.allanninal.dev/#services): 12 services — AI automation, web apps & sites, SaaS from scratch, AI integrations, data & AI/ML, fixes & refactors, QA & testing, AWS DevOps, cloud migration, WordPress/Woo, DNS & domains, UI templates.
- [Products](https://www.allanninal.dev/#products): The three things actively maintained — WiseCashAI, the daily template project, and the AWS build blueprints.
- [About](https://www.allanninal.dev/#about): Background, values, and way of working.
- [Contact](https://www.allanninal.dev/#contact): Get in touch via LinkedIn about custom work, part-time engagements, and retainers.

## Templates (free, MIT-licensed)

- [Templates gallery](https://www.allanninal.dev/templates/): A year-long project releasing one free, mobile-first, MIT-licensed website template per day (365 planned, 73 live). Business and creative niches. 40 also have a paid Pro edition ($19) adding the full Astro source and a no-attribution commercial licence, sold via Gumroad: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/websites
- [Pro editions](https://www.allanninal.dev/templates/pro/): Paid editions of selected templates — extra pages, photography, and an extended licence.
- [Custom work](https://www.allanninal.dev/templates/hire/): Contract engagements — custom builds, template adaptation, part-time or retainer engineering, and performance / SEO / accessibility audits.

## Spreadsheets — Excel and Google Sheets workbooks

- [Spreadsheets](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/): 21 working Excel and Google Sheets workbooks ($59-$119) for jobs where the arithmetic is easy to get wrong and expensive when it is. Each has a page explaining the problem in plain language, then the formulas and the verifier result. Sold via Gumroad: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/
- Construction and contracting: WIP schedule (percentage of completion with correct loss accrual), progress billing and schedule of values, cash flow forecast with peak funding need, equipment cost per hour with own-vs-rent break-even, certified payroll and Davis-Bacon fringe annualisation, and five trade-specific bid calculators (electrical, HVAC, roofing, concrete, landscaping).
- Manufacturing and quality: SPC control charts with Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk and AIAG Gage R&R, a 2^4 factorial design of experiments workbook with Lenth's method, and a Monte Carlo simulation engine in native formulas. None need an add-in.
- Property and deal analysis: ten-year underwriting models with real amortisation, levered and unlevered IRR, DSCR and a 25-run sensitivity grid, for self-storage, car wash, RV park, mobile home park and laundromat.
- Importing, food and grants: landed cost and import duty with FOB/CIF basis and freight allocation, recipe costing and menu engineering with yield-adjusted plate cost, and a federal grant budget with MTDC indirect cost.
- Every workbook is one .xlsx with no macros and no add-ins, so it opens in Excel, Google Sheets, Apple Numbers and LibreOffice Calc. Each one's maths is reimplemented independently in Python and diffed against the recalculated file.

## Build — AWS automation blueprints

- [Build](https://www.allanninal.dev/build/): 73 diagram-first design walkthroughs of small, load-bearing cloud systems on AWS. Each blueprint pairs an "on AWS" overview with an engineering reference. Not no-code — real infrastructure (Lambda, Step Functions, Bedrock).
